_comment: Pinned signing vectors generated by `pnpm sign catalog --vectors` (tools/sign/vectors.ts). Domain: chainId 31337, verifyingContract 0x5e…5e. Keys: well-known local `player` (action key) and `engine` (admin). Numbers are decimal strings; hashes/addresses hex. The JSON numbers are `chainId`, `prepareWindow`, `draw.createDrawRoundAuth.drawWindow`, action `path` and `sequence`, and in `payoutTerms` the node `options`, `losers`, `next` and `maxMultiplierMilli` (`houseEdgeWad` is a string). The top-level round closes by cash-out. `payoutTerms`: named terms with their hashPayoutTerms `hash` (`scheduleVector` names the test/vectors/payout-schedule.json vector with the same terms). `closes`: one full round per close path on the same domain and keys (`function` is the registry call that ends it; `terms` names a payoutTerms entry; payouts come from expectedPayout and equal the named schedule vector's last step; `closeRoundAuth` only for closeRound; `canceled` instead of `result`/`closed` for cancelReadyRound). Consumed by test/foundry/Vectors.t.sol (which also replays every close against a registry at the vector address) and test/hardhat/signing/vectors.test.ts.

PlayerAction.encodeType: PlayerAction(string action,uint8[] path,uint32 sequence,bytes32 round,bytes32 previous)

PlayerCashOut.encodeType: PlayerCashOut(string action,uint8[] path,uint32 sequence,bytes32 round,bytes32 previous)

PlayerCancel.encodeType: PlayerCancel(string action,uint8[] path,uint32 sequence,bytes32 round,bytes32 previous)

CloseRoundAuth.encodeType: CloseRoundAuth(bytes32 roundId,uint128 payoutAmount,bool expired,bytes32 resultHash,bytes32 lastActionHash,uint256 expiry)

draw._comment: DrawRoundRegistry vectors. Domain: SuperEngine v1, chainId 31337, verifyingContract 0xd5…d5. Admin key: `engine`. Consumed by test/foundry/Vectors.t.sol (Vectors_Test) and test/hardhat/signing/vectors.test.ts.

closes.description: Cash or Crash, two picks then cash-out: m2 = 2182.5 floored, payout 2000 * 2182 / 1000 = 4364
Cash or Crash capped at 2.5x, three picks then cash-out: the cap binds on the last step
25 nodes of 25 options, 25 picks then cash-out: the longest path and the most options
Cash or Crash, one pick that loses: not expired, payout 0
Cash or Crash, two picks then the deadline: expired close at expectedPayout(path), lastActionHash = T_2
Cash or Crash, no action before the deadline: expireRound refunds the bet, lastActionHash = 0
Cash or Crash, one recorded pick, then the player's own cash-out after the deadline
Unchecked terms, one action with an empty path, expired close at the cap bet * 5000 / 1000
Cash or Crash, the player's PlayerCancel before any action: canceled = keccak256(abi.encode(ready, T_1))
